input.title: Women's Wrestling Mom – Your Weigh-In, My Stress Snacks Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

A mom with a high ponytail sits in the bleachers hugging a giant striped popcorn tub, candy wrappers piling up beside her, eyes locked on an old balance scale at the edge of the mat, and the hoodie says YOUR WEIGH-IN. MY STRESS SNACKS. This wrestling mom hoodie is for the mom at tournament Saturdays, dual meets and 6 a.m. weigh-ins who is not the one cutting weight.

The print is a 1950s cartoon scene: a wide-eyed mom in a hot pink zip-up jacket and mustard track pants perched on a bleacher bench with a popcorn tub in her arms and a candy wrapper at her side, an upright balance scale standing at the corner of a wrestling mat. YOUR WEIGH-IN. runs across the top in tall capitals and MY STRESS SNACKS. across the bottom in hot pink slab letters.

Wear it to the tournament gym, the car ride to a dual meet or the team potluck, and give it to the wrestling mom whose snack bag is for nerves. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What is the Your Weigh-In, My Stress Snacks hoodie?
It is a pullover graphic hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. showing a wide-eyed wrestling mom with a popcorn tub next to a weigh-in scale, lettered YOUR WEIGH-IN. MY STRESS SNACKS. It is a Gildan 18500 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece with a double-lined hood, drawcord and front pouch pocket.

How does the pullover hoodie fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with ribbed cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a roomier layer over a tee or sweater. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it for a cold gym?
The hoodie is 50% pre-shrunk cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a chilly gym, drafty bleachers or an early parking lot. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low so the hot pink and navy inks stay bright and the fleece stays soft.

Is it a good gift for a wrestling mom?
Yes. It suits the wrestling mom, the team mom and the friend who packs the snacks for the whole team. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $39.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for the season opener, a birthday or Christmas.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. wrestling mom hoodie should arrive before Christmas. Each hoodie is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
